predictedBugs: A reused campaignId with different subject/body could enqueue data inconsistent with the persisted jobs row; guarded with a 409 conflict.
An interrupted addBulk can persist only part of the Redis jobs; deterministic Bull job IDs make the operation safe to retry.
An active Bull job at shutdown may already have reached Mailgrid without a local status update; reconciliation blocks it as uncertain instead of resending.
Malformed Bull timestamps could create invalid PostgreSQL dates; reconciliation now falls back to a valid current timestamp.

Treating a hash absent from PostgreSQL as absent from Redis could hide legacy orphan jobs from this incident; the normal endpoint now always inspects Bull and only scoped recovery may use a dry-run-proven missing set.
Reusing a campaignId with changed template variables could enqueue content different from the persisted campaign; canonical payload comparison now rejects it with HTTP 409.
A webhook may advance a sent log to delivered or bounce before reconciliation; compatible terminal progression is now preserved instead of being reported as a conflict.

Production Docker services expose credentials through *_FILE variables; ignoring those variables makes the backend fall back to development credentials while backup scripts still authenticate successfully. The shared secret reader now covers PostgreSQL, migrations, Redis and Bull.
edgeCases: An empty recipient batch returns a zero summary without opening a transaction.
A 3,908-recipient campaign is split into four inserts and each stays below 65,535 bind parameters.
Completed Bull jobs without a trustworthy return value remain uncertain and block apply.
A pending database campaign with no Redis jobs is reported and requires explicit campaign confirmation before enqueue.
Failed or bounced recipients require a campaign-scoped confirmation and cannot be retried through the ordinary send endpoint.
Object key order differences in template variables remain equivalent, while actual value differences block campaign reuse.
